detail.longDescription: THE PRESIDENT IS ON THE LINE. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was LIVE onstage when Trump called to weigh in on AI risks and regulation. His verdict? “IT’S A HOAX…The robots are not going to be taking over the world.” The orange-haired buffoon barges in, dismisses the experts and offers NO solutions. The stakes are GLOBAL.
